text:
Turn text into embeddings without giving callers the Voyage key. Embed text, or pass one JSON request to a Voyage endpoint. Start with embed and your text.
embed <text...>: Get an embedding for text. Send the text, or JSON that also names a model and input_type.
  text (string): Text to embed; JSON also accepts model and input_type
request <path> <body...>: Call a Voyage /v1/ endpoint, such as rerank, with a JSON body that is sent unchanged.
  path (string): Voyage endpoint path beginning /v1/
  body (string): Raw JSON request bytes
